semiconductor_relevance: High — LINTEC specializes in fluid control technology essential for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: LINTEC Co., Ltd. is a pioneer in fluid measurement and control technologies, focusing on the development of mass flow controllers and liquid vaporization systems for semiconductor applications. Their products are critical for precise gas and liquid flow management in various semiconductor fabrication processes.
capabilities: Mass flow controllers for gas and liquid

regional_presence.Asia: LINTEC is focused on forging strong partnerships in Asia, particularly in India.
